subject: Overdue Payment Reminder
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

This is a reminder that you have $overdue_count overdue fee(s) totaling £$total_amount.

Student ID: $student_id

Please make payment as soon as possible to avoid any service disruptions or holds on your account.

You can pay through:
• Your student portal online
• The Finance Office during business hours
• Bank transfer to the university account

If you have already made this payment, please disregard this notice.

For questions or payment arrangements, please contact:
Finance Office
Email: finance@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567

Thank you,
University Finance Department
